vlskin-bodywash-500ml.name: VLSKIN
vlskin-bodywash-500ml.shortDescription: Suitable for daily use. Gentle by nature 500ml
vlskin-bodywash-500ml.longDescription: VLSkin Bodywash is formulated with premium ingredients to provide gentle yet effective cleansing for all skin types. Our advanced formula creates fine, comfortable foam that thoroughly cleanses while maintaining your skin's natural moisture balance. Perfect for daily use by the whole family, this bodywash leaves your skin feeling refreshed, clean, and soft without any harsh chemicals or artificial fragrances.
vlskin-bodywash-500ml.howToUse: Wet the body, pour onto palm or sponge, lather gently all over, then rinse thoroughly.

vlskin-clay-bar-soap-80gm.name: VLSKIN
vlskin-clay-bar-soap-80gm.longDescription: VLSkin Clay Bar Soap combines the natural cleansing power of clay with gentle moisturizing properties. This compact 80gm bar is perfect for travel and daily use, providing effective cleansing without stripping your skin of its natural oils. The clay formula helps to remove impurities while leaving your skin feeling smooth and refreshed. Its solid form makes it more economical and environmentally friendly compared to liquid soaps.
vlskin-clay-bar-soap-80gm.howToUse: Lather onto palm or sponge, apply to skin, then rinse thoroughly.

vlsuper-sertu-liquid-clay-500ml.name: VLSUPER
vlsuper-sertu-liquid-clay-500ml.longDescription: VLSuper Sertu Liquid Clay provides a consistent and practical solution for sertu cleansing according to Islamic principles. This pre-mixed clay solution eliminates the guesswork in preparing the correct clay mixture for cleansing najis mughallazah. The liquid form ensures even distribution and effective cleansing on various surfaces including metal, plastic, glass, and floors. Available in both household and industrial sizes to meet different needs.
keyBenefits: Simple solution for sertu cleansing of najis mughallazah
Suitable for metal, plastic, glass & floor surfaces
howToUse: Wash once with water mixed with Premix Sertu Solution
Rinse 6 more times with clean water

vlsuper-natural-sanitizer-200ml.name: VLSUPER
vlsuper-natural-sanitizer-200ml.longDescription: VLSuper Natural Sanitizer offers effective hand and surface sanitization using natural ingredients. This 200ml spray bottle provides quick-drying, non-sticky sanitization that's comfortable for daily use. The compact size makes it perfect for travel, office, or personal use. Formulated with natural ingredients, it provides reliable sanitization without harsh chemicals, making it safe for frequent use by the whole family.
keyBenefits: Small size, perfect for travel & pocket use
vlsuper-natural-sanitizer-200ml.howToUse: Spray onto hands or surfaces, rub evenly & let dry.

clayWaterEnzyme.title: Why Clay Water Enzyme?
clayWaterEnzyme.description: We believe true cleanliness starts from the most basic element: earth. Clay Water Enzyme (CWE) is a kaolin clay–based innovation that is not only cleansing, but also safe, natural, and acts as a natural antiseptic.

benefits.title: Natural origin
benefits.description: Kaolin clay has been used for centuries as a cleansing and detoxifying agent. We combine it with enzyme technology for maximum effectiveness.

benefits.title: Health & safety

benefits.title: Meet Fiqh Requirement

benefits.title: Versatile use
benefits.description: From personal care and daily sanitation to halal industry needs, CWE fits modern lifestyles.

clayWaterEnzyme.conclusion: With CWE, we aim to deliver hygiene solutions that are cleaner, safer, and more blessed.

mission.paragraph1: Vital Life Solution Sdn. Bhd. stands at the intersection of science, sustainability, and ethical innovation. Our mission is to develop advanced, responsible wellness solutions — from bodycare to hygiene and purification technologies.
mission.paragraph2: Driven by research and guided by integrity, every VLS product is created with an unwavering commitment to safety, efficacy, and environmental care. We believe technology and ethics can coexist — shaping cleaner, smarter, and more sustainable solutions for modern living.
mission.paragraph3: In a world dominated by synthetic alternatives, we return to nature — rediscovering the cleansing power of pure clay, refined and enhanced through science. At the heart of every formulation lies our Clay Water Enzyme technology, developed through a specialized process that unlocks natural antibacterial, detoxifying, and purifying properties.
mission.paragraph4: This is more than cleanliness — it's about restoring balance to the skin, the home, and the environment. Each product is free from harsh chemicals, safe for daily use, and designed to deliver visible results while remaining gentle on people and the planet. From body washes to multipurpose cleaners, every VLS solution is crafted with purpose: to care, to cleanse, and to protect — offering natural purity, powered by nature, perfected through innovation.

ourClay.title: Natural Purity in Every Drop
ourClay.subtitle: Purity drawn from the earth, refined by science — gentle, safe, and powerful for everyday life.

sections.title: The Purity Beneath. The Power Within.
sections.text: Beneath every surface we cleanse lies a story — of earth, water, and transformation. Our clay originates from naturally rich kaolin deposits, refined through Clay Water Enzyme Technology. From raw mineral to perfected formula, every drop carries the essence of natural purity — gentle, safe, and effective for daily use.

sections.title: The History of Kaolin
sections.text: Kaolin, or white clay, was first discovered in China around 300 BC. Treasured for centuries in porcelain and medicine, it later transformed industries worldwide — from ceramics to skincare — admired for its purity and natural cleansing power.

sections.title: Where Nature Meets Innovation
sections.text: Our process uses advanced nanotechnology to extract the Clay Water Enzyme directly from kaolin — producing a powerful yet gentle base that purifies, protects, and revitalizes both skin and surfaces.

sections.title: Purity You Can Feel
sections.text: Each product is powered by the same principle — purity through simplicity. No harsh chemicals. No unnecessary additives. Just clean innovation born from clay, water, and science.
